releases.notes:
> [!WARNING]
> **BETA / pre-release.** Version 3 is a full multi-platform rewrite. It was tested with in-game self tests on every supported version during development, but test it on a copy of your server first and **make a backup** before updating from 2.x. Please report any problem on GitHub or Discord.

----

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Happyuky7/SEPARE-WORLD-ITEMS/compare/2.0.0...3.0.0-beta-1

**Discord:** https://discord.gg/3EebYUyeUX

**Wiki:** https://github.com/Happyuky7/SEPARE-WORLD-ITEMS/wiki

---

## Highlights

- SepareWorldItems now runs as a **Bukkit plugin** _and_ as a **Fabric / NeoForge / Forge mod** (dedicated server, singleplayer and LAN).
- One shared core, one config format and one developer API for every platform.
- Plugin support from **Minecraft 1.8.8 to 26.x**, with one jar per Java level.
- **WorldGuard 6** (1.8.8 - 1.12.2) and **WorldGuard 7** (1.13 - 26.x) regions.
- Storage: YAML / SQLite / MySQL / MariaDB / MongoDB / Redis on every platform.

---

## Which file do I download?

### Plugin (Spigot, Paper, Purpur, Folia)

| Jar | Minecraft | Server Java |
|-----|-----------|-------------|
| `SepareWorldItems-bukkit-3.0.0-beta-1-java8.jar` | 1.8.8 - 1.16.5 | 8+ |
| `SepareWorldItems-bukkit-3.0.0-beta-1-java17.jar` | 1.17 - 1.20.4 | 17+ |
| `SepareWorldItems-bukkit-3.0.0-beta-1-java21.jar` | 1.20.5 - 26.x | 21+ |

### Mods: `SepareWorldItems-<loader>-<minecraft>-3.0.0-beta-1.jar`

| Minecraft | Fabric | NeoForge | Forge |
|-----------|--------|----------|-------|
| 26.3, 26.2, 26.1.2 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 1.21.11 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 1.21.1 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 1.20.6, 1.19.4, 1.18.2 | ✅ | - | - |
| 1.16.5 | ✅ | - | - |
| 1.12.2 | ✅ (Legacy Fabric) | - | - |

Fabric needs Fabric API (1.12.2 needs Legacy Fabric API).

`separeworlditems-api-3.0.0-beta-1.jar` is for developers only, do not put it on a server.

---

## New

- **Mods** (Fabric / NeoForge / Forge):
  - Config in `config/separeworlditems/config.yml` (same keys as the plugin; worlds are dimension ids such as `"minecraft:the_nether"`).
  - Data and backups inside each world save (`<world>/separeworlditems/`).
  - Commands: `/swi`, `/swi group [player]`, `/swi reload`, `/swi backup`. Permission `separeworlditems.admin` (LuckPerms supported, OP level 2 otherwise).
  - Integrations, enabled automatically: Curios, Trinkets, Accessories (extra slots saved per group), YAWP, Flan, Open Parties and Claims (group per region / claim / party), and items from Create and other content mods kept with all their data.
  - Items that do not fit in the destination group are given back to the player, never deleted.
- **Plugin**: builds for Java 8 / 17 / 21, WorldGuard 6 support, MongoDB and Redis storage.
- **Developer API**: `com.github.happyuky7:separeworlditems-api:3.0.0-beta-1` (Java 8+, Gradle and Maven): groups, player data, events and custom data sections, the same on the plugin and the mods.
- **Languages**: new `mod:` messages (en_US, es_ES), `lang-version` 3.0.0-beta-1.

## Dependencies (bundled)

- sqlite-jdbc `3.54.1.0`, mariadb-java-client `3.5.11`, mysql-connector-j `9.7.0`
- mongodb-driver-sync `5.15.0`, jedis `5.1.5`, commons-pool2 `2.13.1`, org.json `20260814`

## Notes / Warnings

- This is a **BETA**: keep backups and test before production.
- Mods store items as SNBT and the plugin in Bukkit format: **a mod server and a plugin server must not share the same database**. Mods refuse to switch groups (instead of losing items) if they find plugin records.

## Upgrade notes

- Make a full backup of `plugins/SepareWorldItems/` before upgrading from 2.x.
- 2.x `config.yml` files are upgraded automatically (same keys).

This is a major rewrite/recode release.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Happyuky7/SEPARE-WORLD-ITEMS/compare/1.2.26...2.0.0

**Discord:** https://discord.gg/3EebYUyeUX

Download Directories:

- [Download SepareWorldItems Lasted Update](https://github.com/Happyuky7/SEPARE-WORLD-ITEMS/blob/master/SepareWorldItems-Downloads/Updates/)

---

## Highlights

- Folia support
- WorldGuard integration (BETA)
- Multiple storage backends (YAML / SQLite / MySQL / MariaDB / MongoDB / Redis)
- Any → Any migration between backends
- Backups (scheduled + manual)
- Change-logs (audit snapshots) with minimum 30 days retention
- Critical actions confirmation workflow (`confirm <code>` / `cancel`)
- Updated translations / multi-language support

---

## New

- Storage system rewrite with selectable backends.
- Backup system:
  - scheduled backups
  - manual backups (`/swi backup`)
  - optional remote snapshot export for DB backends
- Change-logs (audit): snapshot logs + retention cleanup.
- Config improvements for SQL:
  - `storage.sql.jdbc-url` support
  - or host/port/database/parameters fields

## Fixes / Stability

- WorldGuard region switching only applies inside configured regions (ignores `__global__`).
- Reduced risk of inventory overwrite in rapid world/region transitions by serializing per-player switching.
- Improved stability for remote DB backends via async operations (recommended for remote MySQL/MariaDB).

## Commands

- `/separeworlditems` (aliases: `/swi`, `/separeitems`)
- New confirmation flow for critical actions:
  - `/swi confirm <code>`
  - `/swi cancel`

## Notes / Warnings

- YAML and SQLite are the most stable options.
- MySQL/MariaDB/MongoDB/Redis are **BETA** in 2.0.0.
- WorldGuard region switching is **BETA**: test before production and keep backups.

## Upgrade notes

- This is a major update: make a full server backup before upgrading.
- If you have an old config, regenerate it and re-apply settings.
- If you plan to migrate storage, do a manual backup first.
